verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud is a SaaS that handles customer data, so a training-data privacy question is a fair one for this product. The evidence pack, however, has no policy or control about AI model training or opting out of it. The security docs mention end-to-end encryption, orchestration 'without ever accessing your sensitive data', and compliance certifications. These are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented commitment or setting that keeps customer data out of AI training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
